title: Parsing a unique game
statement: For a natural number $q$ and a Boolean list, first parse the list as rows of natural numbers, requiring every literal to be positive. Then parse each row as a valid unique game constraint for $q$; return the list of constraints if all rows parse successfully, and no result otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a list of Boolean values
